page: Google Cloud Platform n2d-standard-224 is a general-purpose server instance powered by the AMD EPYC 7B13 processor. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 224 vCPUs mapped to 112 physical cores with multithreading enabled. It is equipped with 896 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core and Passmark CPU scores ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. Memory performance is also highly competitive; the instance achieves top-tier read-only small block memory bandwidth of 12510.38 GB/sec and strong large-block read and write bandwidth. For database workloads, it demonstrates high throughput, executing 187.57 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks.

While the instance excels in highly parallelized tasks such as software compilation and ray tracing, single-core performance is moderate, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core tests. Additionally, without GPU acceleration, large language model inference is a notable bottleneck, with text generation for a 70B model falling into the bottom 25% at 2.56 tokens per second. Consequently, this instance is optimized for large-scale general-purpose workloads, high-throughput web serving, database operations, and multi-threaded CPU tasks rather than heavy LLM text generation.
